dimensions.question: Is every Things to say entry, exchange line, alternative and Word something this learner is likely to say or hear in this situation and would want on a card? Padding, alternatives that only reword another option, low-value Words and material that belongs to another topic lower it. A missing item counts against coverage, not usefulness. An empty Words list can be appropriate.
Are meaning, supplied facts, register, learner level and teaching correct and contextually appropriate?
Can the learner initiate and accomplish this contextual task?
Does the English sound natural, and can each Things to say entry and exchange line be lifted and reused on its own?
Are roles, alternatives and progression usable? Repetition alone is not a material failure.
Are the dictionary words relevant, reusable, broad and unpadded, with truthful forms, meanings and evidence? An empty list can be appropriate.
